item.text:
Refactored both classes to push the heavy control flow into smaller helpers and make the top-level lifecycle methods easier to scan.

What changed:
- [`TermuxActivity`](file:///Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/G005_termux/app/src/main/java/com/termux/app/TermuxActivity.java#L200) now splits startup into `initializeActivityState`, `initializeActivityContent`, `initializeViews`, and `startAndBindService`.
- Service binding in [`TermuxActivity`](file:///Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/G005_termux/app/src/main/java/com/termux/app/TermuxActivity.java#L401) is broken into `handleServiceConnectedIntent`, `handleEmptyServiceSessionState`, and `handleExistingServiceSessionState`.
- Context-menu handling in [`TermuxActivity`](file:///Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/G005_termux/app/src/main/java/com/termux/app/TermuxActivity.java#L677) now routes through `handleContextMenuSelection` instead of keeping the whole switch inline.
- [`TermuxService`](file:///Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/G005_termux/app/src/main/java/com/termux/app/TermuxService.java#L134) now delegates `onStartCommand` through `handleStartCommandIntent` and `handleStartCommandAction`.
- Intent parsing for plugin execution moved into `createExecutionCommandFromIntent` in [`TermuxService`](file:///Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/G005_termux/app/src/main/java/com/termux/app/TermuxService.java#L395).
- The duplicated task/session creation flow was consolidated with `createOrReuseShellCommand` in [`TermuxService`](file:///Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/G005_termux/app/src/main/java/com/termux/app/TermuxService.java#L672).
